description: Knowledge about money, markets, investing, trading, economics, and financial systems.

topics.name: Financial Fundamentals
knowledge: Finance is the management of money, assets, investments, and financial decisions.
Income, expenses, savings, and investments are important parts of personal and business finance.
Financial decisions involve balancing risk, reward, and available resources.

topics.name: Markets
knowledge: Financial markets allow people and organizations to buy and sell assets.
Stock markets involve ownership shares of companies.
Currency markets exchange one currency for another.
Commodity markets involve resources such as gold, oil, and agricultural products.

topics.name: Trading Concepts
knowledge: Trading involves buying and selling assets based on market conditions.
Traders analyze price movements, volume, trends, and market information.
Risk management is essential for protecting capital.
A trading strategy defines rules for entering and exiting positions.

topics.name: Technical Analysis
knowledge: Technical analysis studies historical price data to identify possible patterns.
Charts display price movement over time.
Indicators can help analyze trends, momentum, and volatility.
Technical analysis does not guarantee future results.

topics.name: Fundamental Analysis
knowledge: Fundamental analysis evaluates the value of an asset using economic and company information.
Businesses can be analyzed using revenue, profit, growth, and financial reports.
Economic factors can influence markets.

topics.name: Risk Management
knowledge: Risk management reduces the impact of unexpected losses.
Position sizing controls how much capital is exposed to a trade.
Diversification spreads risk across different assets.
Successful systems focus on consistency and discipline.

topics.name: Trading Technology
knowledge: Trading platforms provide tools for analyzing and managing trades.
Algorithms can automate parts of trading processes.
Artificial intelligence can analyze large amounts of market data.
Automated systems require testing, monitoring, and responsible use.
